name: Calendar and daily notes
description: Obsidian-compatible daily notes with a calendar in the sidebar.

folder.label: Daily notes folder
folder.description: Folder of the vault where new daily notes are created. Leave empty to use the vault root.

format.label: Date format
format.description: File name of each daily note, with Obsidian (moment) tokens such as YYYY, MM and DD. Use / to create subfolders, e.g. YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.

template.label: Template file
template.description: Vault path of a note used as the starting content, e.g. Templates/Daily. Obsidian variables in double braces are filled in: date, date:FORMAT, time, time:FORMAT, title, yesterday and tomorrow.

weekStart.label: First day of the week
weekStart.description: Day the calendar weeks start on.

openOnStartup.label: Open today's note on startup
openOnStartup.description: When a window opens with a folder, open today's daily note.

panel.title: Calendar
panel.noFolder: Open a folder to use daily notes.

notify.noFolder: Open a folder to use daily notes.
notify.notDailyNote: The active note is not a daily note.
notify.noPrevious: There is no earlier daily note.
notify.noNext: There is no later daily note.
notify.invalidFormat: The date format "{format}" does not produce a file name. Check the daily notes settings.
notify.templateMissing: Could not read the template "{path}". The daily note was created empty.
notify.openFailed: Could not open the daily note: {message}
